config.content:
## Sítio Guaratinguetá - External Integrations

Diagnóstico técnico de Open-Meteo, Embrapa Agrofit e futuras fontes. O estado operacional exibido no ERP continua vindo do SQL Server.

data_source.query: FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "integration.sync.completed" | STATS completed = COUNT()
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "integration.sync.failed" | STATS failures = COUNT()
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "integration.http.rate_limited" | STATS rate_limited = COUNT()
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "integration.http.timeout" | STATS timeouts = COUNT()

FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action IN ("integration.sync.completed", "integration.sync.failed") | EVAL result = CONCAT(integration.source, " / ", event.action) | STATS count = COUNT() BY result | SORT count DESC

FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action IN ("integration.sync.completed", "integration.sync.failed") | EVAL duration_ms = TO_DOUBLE(event.duration) / 1000000 | STATS avg_duration_ms = AVG(duration_ms) BY integration.source
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action LIKE "integration.http.*" | EVAL attempts = TO_INTEGER(retry.attempts) | STATS calls = COUNT(), avg_attempts = AVG(attempts) BY integration.source
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE module == "integracao" AND error.code IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT() BY error.code | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 15
